root.label: Iraq militia deadline slips to June 2027

events.label: Iraq militia deadline slips to June 2027

slots.name: disarmament deadline
slots.sentence: Iraq had originally set a Sept. 30 deadline — coinciding with the U.S.-led coalition’s withdrawal — for armed groups to lay down their weapons or come under state authority. That deadline has since slipped to June 2027 as some powerful factions resist disarmament.

slots.name: group support status
slots.sentence: Hussein said one group had issued a statement Thursday backing the government’s plan and another was expected to follow within a day, while negotiations continued with others.
